adjoint_and_source_interface.axial_selection: quadratic sources must still be projected onto H, P_x, J_i, and the electric harmonic row; a zero H projection alone remains inconclusive

conformal_stabilizer_argument: the nonzero product Weyl tensor has distinct factor-plane eigendistributions, so a connected conformal stabilizer preserves the product splitting
the common conformal factor on the two factors is constant; integrating the S2 divergence forces it to zero
periodicity removes the flat-cylinder boost, leaving partial_t, partial_x, and the three SO(3) rotations
there is no nonzero Weyl compensator in a background stabilizer
imported_universal_targets.constant_u1_reducibility: its integrated Gauss identity on closed Sigma is a boundary-zero identity, not an additional independent Taub charge
imported_universal_targets.magnetic_target: excluded from the tangent/correction space because c_1(P_N) is fixed
imported_universal_targets.maxwell_harmonic_target: the electric harmonic-flux row dual to the H^1(S1) generator dx; it is separate from the constant U(1) Noether identity
imported_universal_targets.open_extra_targets: fourth-order constraint-adjoint classes not generated by background stabilizers must still be solved blockwise

source_projectors.J_i: integral_Sigma n^a S_ab (J_i)^b with the patchwise Maxwell compensation

claim_boundary: This LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC/REDUCED-MODE G1 theorem certifies the complete standard axial harmonic master complex for all S1 momenta, ell, and m on the fixed compact bundle, including its periodic gauge quotient, exact dispersion, global ell=1 twist, and reduced conserved pairing. It does not certify the polar complex, covariant symplectic normalization, extra fourth-order adjoint cokernel, quadratic obstruction coefficients, causal propagation, scattering, or quantum theory.

domain.gauge_group: smooth periodic identity-component Diff x U(1)
domain.harmonics: axial metric sector built from Y_(ell,m), ell>=1, all m
domain.spacetime: R_t x S1_L x S2 on fixed compact U(1) bundle P_N, N=2
domain.stage: Einstein-Maxwell tangent domain before residual quotient

ell1_quotient.global_zero_mode: omega=k=0, q_x/H_x=-1, retained in the fixed product-periodicity domain
ell1_quotient.n_zero: the local gauge vector at omega=k=0 is zero and does not generate the constant H_x=-q_x twist; a generator proportional to x is nonperiodic, so the global twist remains
ell1_quotient.periodic_nonzero_n: the lambda-2 null vector is generated by a periodic Fourier gauge parameter and is removed; the physical plus branch has omega^2=k_n^2+4

gauge_fixing_and_reconstruction.ell_1: X_(ab)=0; h_2 is absent and the combined residual r=-s acts as delta h_A=partial_A s, delta q_A=-partial_A s
gauge_fixing_and_reconstruction.ell_ge_2: X_(ab) is nonzero; h_2=0 fixes s uniquely and b=0 then fixes r uniquely, leaving h_A,q_A with no residual smooth gauge
gauge_fixing_and_reconstruction.reconstruction_scope: complete within the standard axial harmonic decomposition; polar/even coefficients are a separate block

next_gate: derive the polar/even master complex and match both reduced currents to the covariant Einstein-Maxwell symplectic form before solving the extra fourth-order adjoint blocks

reduced_pairing.Cauchy_pairing: integral_(S1) [u^T W dot(v)-dot(u)^T W v] dx
reduced_pairing.conservation: partial_A j^A=0 because W K=K^T W
reduced_pairing.current: j^A(u,v)=u^T W partial^A v-(partial^A u)^T W v
